definitions.gloss: extinguishing a fire, fire being put out
definitions.explanation: The act or state of a fire being completely put out and brought under control. Used in news reports and official contexts about firefighting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ようやく{鎮火|ちんか}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{消防隊|しょうぼうたい}→消防隊：29848_shouboutai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鎮火|ちんか}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the fire brigade's efforts, the fire was extinguished in three hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山火事|やまかじ}→山火事：19433_yamakaji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧たって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{鎮火|ちんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っていない→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Even after a week, there is no prospect of the wildfire being extinguished.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen in news reports about fires. Describes the fire being completely put out, not just partially controlled. The intransitive use ({鎮火|ちんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = the fire goes out) is more common than the transitive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鎮火|ちんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be extinguished)
- {鎮火|ちんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧ (prospect of extinguishment)
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{鎮火|ちんか} (complete extinguishment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{消火|しょうか}→消火：13291_shouka⟧: firefighting, putting out a fire — the active effort of extinguishing
- {鎮火|ちんか}: the result — the fire being completely out
